subject: Computação
description_pt: Compreender o papel de protocolos para a transmissão de dados. Entender como os dados são armazenados, processados e transmitidos usando dispositivos computacionais, considerando aspectos da segurança cibernética.

components.description_pt: Explicar o papel de protocolos em viabilizar a transmissão de dados entre dispositivos computacionais
components.description_en: Explain the role of protocols in enabling data transmission between computing devices

components.description_pt: Descrever como dados são armazenados e processados em dispositivos computacionais
components.description_en: Describe how data are stored and processed in computing devices
components.cc_component_description: Describe how digitized information is stored in computer memory as binary data arrays

components.description_pt: Descrever como dados são transmitidos entre dispositivos computacionais usando protocolos
components.description_en: Describe how data are transmitted between computing devices using protocols
components.cc_component_description: Describe how digital devices encode and decode information between digital and analog forms

cc_matches.description: Digitized information can be transmitted over long distances without significant degradation. High-tech devices, such as computers or cell phones, can receive and decode information—convert it from digitized form to voice—and vice versa.

Information can be digitized (e.g., a picture stored as the values of an array of pixels); in this form, it can be stored reliably in computer memory and sent over long distances as a series of wave pulses.
